currentPhase: Phase 0/1 — production hardening and controlled mobile expansion
maturity: The real-provider Copilot, durable Trip completion, signed anonymous identity, cost and product-event persistence, three-turn and trusted-IP guards, truthful request states, controlled-preview Human Tasks, legal pages, retention enforcement, durable outbound ledger, Admin-only partner configuration, P0-19 telemetry, and P0-20 public-runtime controls are merged. Execution-fact safety has reviewed safe phrases, fail-closed model bypass/grounding guards, blocking runtime evals, provenance-qualified local addresses, deterministic aliases, and a no-fallback presentation guard. The public home is product-first while /visepanda is the canonical workspace; /copilot redirects there and scenario context remains editable, allowlisted, and unsent until the traveler submits it. Controlled-preproduction foundations include the multi-meter VisePod voice-cost domain ledger, device lifecycle domain, portable OfflineTripPackage contract, mobile red/gold token projection, local-only eight-item Tools content, authenticated read-only Web Trip sync, a privacy-safe mobile telemetry queue, and an authenticated Mobile Human Help form. The mobile Human Help form submits only a Shanghai controlled-preview request after an explicit action; it derives its owner from an online Supabase bearer validation, sends no Trip snapshot or block metadata, retains one idempotency key across an uncertain retry, returns only a receipt, and never queues a write offline. China Readiness is a deterministic ten-question self-check with no score, explicit unknowns, consented server-only persistence, a private RLS/retention boundary, and the responsive /readiness consumer. Rescue Mode's Web consumer, fixed routing, and fail-closed operational configuration are complete. P0-17 now has a private payment ledger, a server-only Stripe hosted-Checkout adapter, an Ops-authorized Checkout composition route, a raw-body signature verifier, an idempotent verified-event consumer, and an owner-scoped pending-payment entry surface. Creator attribution now has an additive private contract: `creator` records are acquisition sources, never outbound destinations; public activation remains unavailable without an operator-created active record and a separately reviewed consumer. The four external advancement tracks have an active runbook and OA-006/OA-019/OA-020/OA-021 records, but none has crossed its factual verification gate. Missing configuration remains unavailable; no card data, secret, provider payload, placeholder success, partner redirect, payment, device service, or paid-task claim is exposed before verified external evidence.
